problems: Cliopatria inverts Chechnya: Russia 1996-1999 and 2006+ contain it, 1992-1995 and 2000-2005 do not (and the Chechen Republic row, eu-19, is a separate state in those years); corrected in russian-federation, the chechen-republic dossier should be reviewed to match.

Treatment of annexed land is inconsistent between dossiers: Crimea and the 2022 Kherson/Zaporizhzhia holdings are occupation_start (hatched) in russian-federation and ukraine, while the DPR/LPR dossiers dissolve into russian-federation (solid gain). The orchestrator must pick one rule.
Hand-over years overlap: russian-federation and ukraine start in 1991 (December and August) and serbia-montenegro ends in June 2006, the same year montenegro and republic-of-serbia begin.

russian-occupied-territories is typed umbrella and british-overseas-territories typed colony: both Cliopatria rows are aggregates; their shapes overlap other dossiers (transnistria, south-ossetia, abkhazia, DPR, LPR; falkland-islands, gibraltar).

Open occupation_start/contest_start events (Crimea, 2022 south, Kursk 2024, Transnistria, Georgia 2008) have no end event, so validate_dossier prints 5 warnings for russian-federation and 3 for ukraine; all six dossiers have 0 errors and no unresolved region names.
The Russo-Ukrainian war page is a short summary; many 2022-2024 dates were not on it. No claims were made from memory.
